input.value: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat

input.rationale: Motor vehicle collision resulting in totaled vehicle and injury to the policyholder; clearly within auto insurance scope.

Vehicle is totaled (exceeds $25k), and policyholder has sustained injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist) including soft-tissue injury with potential for complications; high-impact collision warrants expedited adjuster response.

input.claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15 am yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking, resulting in a totaled vehicle with crush damage to the trunk and back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Third-party insurance information is documented on the police report.
